requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_TOMCAT_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: tomcat-<version>-darwin.zip to install, for example dist/tomcat-0.0.1-darwin.zip
requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_JAVA_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: Lithe-Java-Support-<version>-darwin-<arch>.zip from Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java releases; its java tool launches Tomcat and its java adapter debugs it
requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_TOMCAT_HOME: an unpacked Tomcat, for example .artifacts/tomcat/apache-tomcat-10.1.62 from scripts/test/fetch-tomcat.mjs
requiredEnvironment.JAVA_HOME: a JDK 21 or later: the Java plugin's JDT language server, which runs its java debug adapter, refuses older JDKs; Tomcat also runs on it
